description: A GIS technologist at a logistics firm has loaded 14,000+ real airport records and 67,000+ flight routes from the OpenFlights dataset into Oracle tables AIRPORTS and FLIGHT_ROUTES. A colleague has written 5 analytical queries in /home/ga/Desktop/slow_queries.sql that all perform full table scans and run slowly. Your job: analyze the query execution plans, create appropriate Oracle indexes to speed them up, then save the optimized (index-aware) versions of the same 5 queries to /home/ga/Desktop/optimized_queries.sql. The file must contain all 5 queries separated by semicolons. You must create at least 4 distinct indexes on the AIRPORTS and FLIGHT_ROUTES tables.
